children.name: Bordetella pertussis
children.description: Bordetella pertussis is a Gram-negative, aerobic, pathogenic, encapsulated coccobacillus bacterium of the genus Bordetella.

children.name: Bordetella parapertussis
children.description: Bordetella parapertussis is a small Gram-negative bacterium of the genus Bordetella that is adapted to colonise the mammalian respiratory tract.

children.name: Bordetella bronchiseptica
children.description: Bordetella bronchiseptica is a small, gram-negative, rod-shaped bacterium of the genus Bordetella.

children.name: Castellaniella ginsengisoli
children.description: Castellaniella ginsengisoli is a Gram-negative, oxidase- and catalase-positive, rod-shaped, motile, beta-glucosidase-producing bacterium from the family Alcaligenaceae which has been isolated from soil of a ginseng field in South Korea.

children.name: Castellaniella fermenti
children.description: Castellaniella fermenti is a Gram-negative and aerobic bacterium from the genus Castellaniella which has been isolated from fermented food from Taiwan.

children.name: Advenella incenata
children.authorship: Coenye et al. 2005 emend. Gibello et al. 2009

children.name: Advenella mimigardefordensis
children.description: Advenella mimigardefordensis is a bacterium from the genus Advenella.

children.name: Advenella kashmirensis
children.authorship: (Ghosh et al. 2005) Gibello et al. 2009 emend. Shmareva et al. 2016

children.name: Alcaligenes faecalis
children.description: Alcaligenes faecalis is a species of Gram-negative, rod-shaped bacteria commonly found in the environment.

children.name: Achromobacter marplatensis
children.authorship: Gomila et al. 2011 emend. Vandamme et al. 2013
children.description: Achromobacter marplatensis is a Gram-negative bacterium from the genus Achromobacter which was isolated from a pentachlorophenol-contaminated soil in Mar del Plata by Murialdo et al.

children.name: Achromobacter ruhlandii
children.authorship: (Aragno and Schlegel 1977) Yabuuchi et al. 1998 emend. Vandamme et al. 2013
children.description: Achromobacter ruhlandii is a Gram-negative bacterium included in the order Burkholderiales.

children.name: Achromobacter xylosoxidans
children.authorship: (ex Yabuuchi and Ohyama 1971) Yabuuchi and Yano 1981
children.description: Achromobacter xylosoxidans (formerly Alcaligenes xylosoxidans) is a Gram-negative, aerobic, oxidase and catalase-positive, motile bacterium with peritrichous flagella, from the genus Achromobacter.

children.name: Oligella ureolytica
children.description: Oligella ureolytica is a Gram-negative, aerobic, motile bacterium with peritrichous flagella of the genus Oligella, isolated from a cervical lymph node and human urine.

children.name: Derxia gummosa
children.description: Derxia gummosa is a Gram-negative, rod-shaped, nitrogen-fixing, obligate aerobe bacterium of the genus Derxia.

children.name: Kerstersia similis
children.description: Kerstersia similis is species of gram-negative bacterium of the genus of Kerstersia which was isolated from human clinical samples.
